issue.title: Events with same target are not detached if one is attached when "outside angular"

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Indicates than the issue relates to something that worked in a previous version

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

issue.body:
## I'm submitting a... 

[x] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
[ ] Bug report  
[ ] Feature request
[ ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
## Current behavior If two DOM event handlers are attached to the same element via the renderer, where one is attached outside Angular and the other "inside" Angular, the later cannot be detached. This seems to be due to the fact that the decision about how the event should be detached is based on an expando [attached to the targeted DOM element](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/200d92d0301ef4c584cb7d69366bde3395157e96/packages/platform-browser/src/dom/events/dom_events.ts#L191). Maybe this information can be passed directly via the closure or attached to the callback instead. ## Expected behavior I would expect to be able to detach events. ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions The behavior is easily re-producible in the following plunker http://plnkr.co/edit/RXhEXHwsXWr197WRctIw?p=preview Just click on the document, you will noticed that two alerts are shown, instead of just one, as one of the click handlers is detached. ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? ## Environment Angular version: 5.0.0

issue.title: The listener on document click cannot be removed if Grid display in the page

repository.name: kendo-angular
repository.description: Issue tracker - Kendo UI for Angular

issue.body:
I want to implement a function like downdroplist. When the dropdown items display, add a listener (document : click) that when user click outside of dropdownlist, the dropdown items disappear. Then remove the listener to avoid unused listen. Since this component works as dropdownlist that it will be displayed multiple times in one page and it may be released and re-generated, removing the listener is necessary, otherwise, it would lead to performance issue.
However, I found that when there is Grid display in the page, it could not work as expect. Could you please help provide a workaround?

I wrote an example: (Angular 5.0.2 and Kendo-Grid: 3.5.0)
 https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-502-grid
Note: I also did try with different versions of Kendo-Grid (1.7.2 and 2.1.3), and they had the same issue.

Case 1: (unexpect result)
Steps:
1. Open Developer Tool (F12)
2. Click button 'Add Handler'
3. Click any area in the document
4. Click button 'Unbind Handler'
5. Click any area in the document many times
Check the console output, you can find output from console as following:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33855404/45674154-53bb6c80-bae1-11e8-85b1-659b20879b71.png)
**Note: The method that remove the listener was called, however, there is still new output from console.**

Case 2: (correct result)
Steps:
1. Open Developer Tool (F12)
2. Comment out code related to kendo-grid in file app.component.html
3. Refresh the preview window through clicking refresh icon as below
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33855404/45674527-28854d00-bae2-11e8-9c3e-fd77a0721bf1.png)
4. Click button 'Add Handler'
5. Click any area in the document
6. Click button 'Unbind Handler'
7. Click any area in the document many times
Check the console output, you can find output from console as following: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33855404/45674650-62eeea00-bae2-11e8-9465-2383e7d0f82a.png)
**Note: When the listener was removed, there was no new output from console.**
